dialogues.text: Wow! You encounter the Basilisk upon entering the Chamber of Secrets..
The enormous serpent raises its head and fixes its deadly gaze in your direction. You need to act fast!
You raise your wand and begin to concentrate. The magical energy crackles in the air around you.
The Basilisk seems badly hurt! You have a chance to strike the final blow.
Focus all your magical energy, and unleash the final spell to defeat the Basilisk!

groups.groupName: well done! Continue to the next page.

dialogues.text: Well done! Your spell has worked perfectly. The Basilisk retreats into the depths of the chamber.
The Chamber of Secrets begins to glow with an ethereal light as peace returns.
Hey! What's that? You find a magical artifact hidden in the chamber..
It seems to be a map.. I wonder what secrets it holds, and where it might lead to.
